Overview

MSCI Data AI Engineering is a central team responsible for building and managing a broad suite of data-centric applications and capabilities that support all MSCI business verticals. 

A core part of our mission is ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across MSCI’s products. The team designs and implements robust AI-driven data quality enhancements to guarantee that downstream analytics, models, and client-facing solutions are built on trusted data.

 

As a member of this team, you will work alongside highly motivated professionals who challenge one another to produce best-in-class products and technology. We stay at the forefront of advancements in LLMs, GenAI, NLP, ML, and modern data science — and lead the planning and deployment of advanced AI and data quality solutions across MSCI’s application landscape.

Responsibilities

Develop data science applications and contribute to MSCI’s ongoing AI adoption journey.

Implement ML/NLP/GenAI/Agentic AI, and advanced anomaly detection methodologies (including statistical, ML-based, and AI-driven approaches) within data science tools to deliver new functionality for both the internal production platform and the client delivery platform.

Support teams across data and technology in implementing AI solutions and integrating their services with MSCI’s data science products and platforms.

Engage with content expert teams across technology and build a deep understanding of MSCI APIs and data delivery platforms.

Collaborate closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Data Operations, and IT Infrastructure throughout all stages of the development lifecycle, ensuring reliable, high-quality, and scalable solutions.

Qualifications
At least a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
5 years of experience in finding patterns in data, creating statistical models, data exploration, data visualization, and data mining.
Experience in developing AI and ML solutions and delivering them to production.
Strong hands-on experience in Python & NLP
Expertise in anomaly detection methodologies, including statistical techniques, ML-based approaches, and AI-driven detection systems for identifying irregularities, data drift, and quality issues.
Prior experience or projects involving LLMs and Agentic AI is a strong plus.
Understanding of good software development practices: Test-Driven Development (TDD), refactoring, pair-programming, and solid design principles.
Self-motivated, proactive, and demonstrating a strong drive toward delivery.
Experience with cloud-based solutions, especially Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools for continuous integration and deployment.

 

What we offer you

Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

Job Description: AI Engineer Agentic AI Development

Job Title: AI Engineer – Agentic AI Development
Experience: 6–8+ years overall experience (4–6+ years in AI development preferred)
Primary Skills: Agentic AI, Python, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vertex AI, Google ADK, AI Evaluation

Project Overview

The project focuses on developing an enterprise-grade Agentic AI platform that leverages specialized Large Language Model (LLM) agents, orchestrated through an Agent Development Kit (ADK), to automate data retrieval, multi-step reasoning, hypothesis validation, and complex decision-making.

The platform incorporates Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) mechanisms to ensure autonomous agent actions align with organizational safety, accuracy, and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and implement sophisticated Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) using Google ADK or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
Build and manage sequential, parallel, and loop-based agent workflows for complex reasoning and automated data processing.
Architect Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows with interrupt-and-resume capabilities for human validation and critical decision-making.
Implement advanced agent reasoning patterns, including ReAct, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and self-reflection, to improve output reliability.
Develop and deploy AI agents and agent-based applications using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Vertex AI.
Optimize long-context processing for large datasets while maintaining response coherence, accuracy, and consistency.
Establish AI evaluation frameworks to assess agent performance using precision, recall, F1 score, faithfulness, trajectory analysis, and defect classification accuracy.
Perform debugging, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous optimization of agent workflows and LLM outputs.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise data sources and knowledge systems to support intelligent information retrieval and decision-making.
Collaborate with customers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, testing, and monitoring for agent-based applications.

Mandatory Skills

Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Vertex AI.
Practical experience developing and deploying Agentic AI solutions.
Experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar frameworks for building and orchestrating AI agents.
Understanding of multi-agent architectures and sequential, iterative, and loop-based workflows.
Experience with AI evaluation methodologies and metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, and agent trajectory evaluation.
Familiarity with LLM tuning and reasoning techniques, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), ReAct, and Chain-of-Thought prompting.
Experience in data analysis, data processing, and integration with LLM-based applications.
Ability to debug complex AI workflows and perform root cause analysis.
Experience deploying and maintaining AI agents in cloud environments.
Familiarity with Human-in-the-Loop implementation, including interrupt-and-resume workflows.
Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and customer collaboration skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

Experience with Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline implementation for multi-agent frameworks.
Experience integrating LLMs with knowledge graphs and enterprise knowledge bases.
Familiarity with memory banks or persistent memory mechanisms for agent-to-agent communication.
Experience with Agile development methodologies and collaborative software engineering practices.
Understanding of production monitoring, AI safety, reliability, and performance optimization.

Qualifications and Experience

6–8+ years of overall relevant technical experience, with 4–6+ years of AI development experience preferred.
Hands-on experience building, testing, and deploying agent-based AI applications.
Experience delivering AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform, particularly Vertex AI.
Practical exposure to Google ADK and multi-agent orchestration.
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Strong technical communication and customer-facing collaboration skills.

Job Summary

Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing. We are assembling a dynamic team to develop and scale our Manufacturing Supply Digital Platform-a next-generation software framework that transforms how manufacturing and supply operations connect, collaborate, and optimize. This platform is not an ERP system. It's a purpose-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle-from design and engineering to production and distribution. This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You'll be part of a team that's not just building software-but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.
As part of this initiative, you'll contribute to:
System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
Automation Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, AI Agents, predictive maintenance, and quality control-without replacing core transactional systems.
Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.


Key Responsibilities

Build, integrate, and optimize AI Assistants and agent-based solutions capable of retrieving information, executing workflows, and supporting business processes through natural language interactions.
Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise data sources, APIs, knowledge bases, document repositories, and business applications to enable accurate and context-aware AI experiences.
Implement prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval, memory management, and agent orchestration techniques to improve response quality, reliability, and user experience.
Develop document ingestion, metadata extraction, chunking, indexing, and knowledge management pipelines to support enterprise search and AI Assistant capabilities.
Evaluate, test, and optimize AI solutions using techniques such as prompt tuning, model selection, caching, reranking, and retrieval optimization to improve accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and domain teams to define requirements, translate business needs into AI capabilities, and deliver production-ready solutions.
Implement observability, monitoring, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms to measure AI Assistant performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement.
Support deployment, productionization, and operational readiness activities, including security, entitlements, access controls, auditability, and governance requirements.
Stay current with advancements in LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and AI platform technologies, and contribute to the adoption of relevant capabilities.


Required Skills

LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar agentic AI frameworks.
Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases (Milvus, Pinecone) and enterprise knowledge base implementations.
Experience building and deploying AI Assistants, Copilots, or conversational AI solutions for business or operational use cases.
Exposure to agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Deep expertise in Python especially with PyTorch/TensorFlow (model training, fine-tuning for vision, text, and audio; Supervised, Unsupervised, Reinforcement learning experience is a plus).
Knowledge of Machine Learning techniques: anomaly detection, predictive analytics


Nice to Have Skills

Knowledge of document ingestion, OCR, metadata extraction, and document processing frameworks such as Textract, Docling, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices.
Familiarity with Graph databases, Knowledge Graphs, and Ontology-based retrieval and reasoning.
Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise platforms through REST APIs, FastAPI, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
Exposure to cloud-based AI services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Amazon Textract, Azure AI Foundry, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of security concepts including OAuth, OIDC, RBAC, entitlements, auditability, and enterprise AI governance.


Educational Background

Typically requires a Bachelor s degree, preferably in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, mathematics, or a similar field with quantitative coursework, and 4-5 years of professional experience utilizing quantitative analysis, a Master s degree and 2-3 years of experience.
This position requires working onsite five days a week.


Additional Information

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on, consultative AI Lead to sit at the front line of client engagements and turn AI ambition into working software. You will run discovery with clients, shape priority use cases into buildable solutions, and then personally build the prototypes, agents, and phase-0 MVPs that create client conviction and accelerate deal conversion.

This is a forward deployed role: you work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients and the account team rather than behind a delivery firewall. Success is measured by how quickly a vague business problem becomes a demonstrable AI capability with a credible value hypothesis.

It sits at the intersection of AI engineering, solution design, and business value — and is best suited to a strong builder who is comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving sales cycles and enjoys being the technical voice in the room.

Roles & Responsibilities

Discovery and use-case shaping
Run early-stage discovery sessions and working groups with clients and account teams.
Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities across the client's process landscape.
Translate vague or complex client questions into clear solution hypotheses, initial architectural logic, and a prioritised use-case backlog.
Build AI scenarios and "before/after" narratives that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes attached.
Build and prove
Design AI solutions end to end for a given use case — LLM choice, prompt and context design, data sources, retrieval, tools, integrations, and a usable front end — working with the AI Architect on platform-level decisions.
Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints at pursuit speed.
Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning quality, safety, and performance; stand up evaluation harnesses so claims are evidence-backed rather than anecdotal.
Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, owning scope, timeline, and the technical outcome.
Client-facing content and conviction
Create client-ready material: solution and architecture decks, demo storylines, value frameworks, effort estimates, and inputs into proposals and SoWs.
Lead technical walkthroughs, deep-dives, and competitive differentiation discussions with client engineering and business stakeholders.
Refine solution narratives based on client feedback, objections, and market conditions.
Continuity and uplift
Own a clean handover from pursuit to delivery — architecture intent, code, decisions, risks, and open questions documented and transferred.
Contribute reusable assets back to the practice: accelerators, agent patterns, eval suites, reference implementations.
Mentor 2–5 engineers on agentic engineering practice and raise the bar on prototype quality.
 Must-have skills and experience

Agentic AI engineering

Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
Practical experience with multi-step and multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, and failure handling (retries, fallbacks, human-in-the-loop).

RAG and context engineering

Strong experience with RAG pipelines: chunking and indexing strategy, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid and re-ranked retrieval, evaluation of retrieval quality.
Working understanding of tokenization, context-window management, and cost/latency trade-offs.

Engineering craft

Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
Hands-on Docker-based deployment and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control, branching, and review — mandatory.
Enough front-end capability (React/Streamlit/Gradio or equivalent) to make a demo feel like a product.

Model provider and hyperscaler GenAI platform know-how

Working familiarity across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscaler AI platforms, with genuine in-depth, hands-on depth in at least one of the following:
Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use, extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool and data connectivity, Claude on Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI.
OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning and batch APIs.
AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and the surrounding data and security services.
Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native integration patterns.
Able to explain why a given provider or platform fits a client's constraints — model capability, context window, latency, cost per interaction, data residency and privacy posture, enterprise controls, existing cloud commitments — rather than defaulting to a personal favourite.
Comfortable building the same use case on more than one stack, and keeping solutions reasonably provider-portable so a client is not architecturally locked in by a prototype.

Consultative ability

Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
Strong communication and articulation skills; able to hold a technical room and a business room in the same meeting.
Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, and LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

 

Good to have
Prior pre-sales, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering exposure.
Depth in one or two industry domains (e.g. BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail, manufacturing, telecom).
Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML track (AWS, Azure or Google), or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).
Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Ollama, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
Exposure to LLM observability and evaluation tooling, and to responsible-AI and data-privacy considerations in regulated environments.
